## Screen recording

Every UI change, feature, or bug fix needs a short recording (15 to 60 seconds) that reviewers can watch inline, or a framed screenshot for a static screen. Fixes and UI changes get a before/after clip; a new feature gets one demo clip. If before and after look the same, skip the video and say so here. Follow the steps in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#screen-recordings). Never commit the video file.
